reviews.comment:
Excelente atención ,muy amables. El baño limpio y accesible tanto par hombres como mujeres el baño accesible, entre y estaba super limpio el baño , había papel!!! Jabón líquido y agua para lavarse, salís y entra una joven muy amorosa a limpiar!!!!! Hay rampa para acceder al kiosco . Un oasis en la ruta!!!!

(Translated by Google)
Excellent service, very friendly. The bathroom was clean and accessible for both men and women. I went in and it was spotless, there was toilet paper! Liquid soap and water for washing. As you leave, a very kind young woman comes in to clean! There's a ramp to access the kiosk. An oasis on the highway!
